You deal less damage and have reduced accuracy. }} '''Enfeeble''' is a [[hex]] [[spell]] that [[curse]]s all targets in an area, lowering their [[damage]] and [[accuracy]]. Enfeeble does not reduce the damage taken from [[reflect]], from a cursed enemy. ==Skill functions and interactions== * All effects of Enfeeble are capped at 75%.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1514557 * Enfeeble can be turned into an [[aura]] by linking it with either {{il|Blasphemy Support}} or {{il|Awakened Blasphemy Support}}.[[File:Enfeeble aura screenshot.png|thumbnail|right|The aura version of Enfeeble]] ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression | c1_abbr = Reduced

Radius |c4_header = +x metres to radius |c4_pattern_extract = %+(%d+%.*%d*) metres? to radius |c4_pattern_value = +%sm }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Related modifiers== ===Item mods=== {{Query spawnable modifiers |where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%enfeeble%" AND domain NOT IN ('3', '5', '17', '18', '22') AND generation_type NOT LIKE "10" |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type=1 |group=1 }} ===Map and area mod=== {{main|List of map suffix mods}} Enfeeble is one of the [[hex]] [[curse]]s that can be rolled on [[maps]] and [[vaal side area]] (known as "secret_area" in spawn weight), the curses affect the entire area and can be removed by having [[curse immunity]] (from items or flasks). The base magnitude of the {{stl|Enfeeble}} debuff is the same as level 1 Enfeeble gem, but further scaled by the map or area mod {{c|mod|with #% increased Effect}}, which that part of the map mod is further affected by [[Atlas]] passives: {{Query spawnable modifiers |where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%enfeeble%" AND domain IN (5, 17, 18, 22) |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type=1 |domain=1 }} The following mod can be found in legacy maps: {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where = mod_stats.id LIKE "%Enfeeble%" AND domain = 5 |q_having = SUM(mod_spawn_weights.value) = 0 |q_groupBy = mod_spawn_weights._pageID |stat_text=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 |spawn_weights=1 }} ===Monsters mods=== {{Modifier table |q_tables = mod_stats, mod_spawn_weights |q_join = mods._pageID=mod_stats._pageID, mods._pageID=mod_spawn_weights._pageID |q_where= domain = "3" AND generation_type NOT IN ( "3", "4" ) AND ( mod_stats.id LIKE "%Enfeeble%" OR mods.id = "MonsterModHexingEffigy" ) |stat_text=1 |spawn_weights=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 }} Legacy monster mods: {{Modifier table |q_where = mods.id IN ("MonsterArchnemesisHexer", "MonsterNemesisCurseDaemon", "MonsterNemesisEnfeebleOnHit") |stat_text=1 |level=1 |generation_type =1 }} {{Skill enchantment modifier list|skill=Enfeeble}} ==Related unique items== {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where= item_stats.id LIKE "%enfeeble%" |level=1 |stat=1 |large=1 }} ==Notable monster versions== On top of monster with above listed monster mod, the following monster also use Enfeeble: * Enfeeble aura in [[Doedre Darktongue]] ([[Act 4]]) boss room * Doedre's Monoliths from the area that led to [[Doedre, Darksoul]] ([[The Rotting Core]] of [[Act 9]]) or [[Doedre the Defiler]] ([[Sepulchre Map]]) boss room, use Enfeeble aura. The following monsters use their own version of Enfeeble skill: {{#cargo_query: |tables=monsters |fields=CONCAT("[[", _pageName, "|", name, "]]")=Monster names, skill_ids |where=skill_ids HOLDS LIKE "%Enfeeble%" AND skill_ids HOLDS NOT LIKE "TriggerDoedreStonePillarEnfeeble" AND skill_ids HOLDS NOT LIKE "Enfeeble" AND monster_type_id NOT LIKE "%LeagueAvatarNormal%" |limit=100 |order by=name }} As of 3.12, Some monster mods use old version (per-3.12) Enfeeble aura: {{ml|DoedreCurseZoneAuraEnfeeble}}, {{ml|DoedreCurseZoneAuraEnfeeble2}}, which affect critical strike as well. {{sl|id=Enfeeble}} and {{stl|Green Effluent}}, {{stl|Doedre's Withering}} are not the same debuffs, despite all have the effect that dealing less damage. ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.20.0| *Now has {{c|mod|Base duration is ('''8-11.8''') seconds}} (previously (9-10.9) seconds). *Now causes {{c|mod|Cursed Normal or Magic enemies deal ('''15-29''')% less Damage}} (previously (21-30)%). *Now causes {{c|mod|Cursed Rare or Unique enemies deal ('''9-18''')% less Damage}} (previously (10-15)%). *Quality no longer grants {{c|mod|(0-10)% increased Effect of Curse}}. Instead, it grants {{c|mod|(0-20)% increased Curse Duration}}. *Anomalous quality no longer grants {{c|mod|Curse has (0-40)% increased Doom gain rate}}. Instead, it now grants {{c|mod|(0-20)% increased Area of Effect}}. }} {{Version history table row|3.12.0| ''All curse skills have been reworked and are now divided into two categories: Hexes and Marks.'' * No longer causes cursed enemies to have reduced critical strike chance or critical strike multiplier. * Curses applied by casting this spell now gain 10 Doom per second. * Now gains additional radius as the gem levels, up to +10 at gem level 20 (from +7). * Now gains 1% increased effect of curse per 2% gem quality (previously granted 1% reduced accuracy rating per 5% gem quality and 1% reduced critical strike chance per 2% gem quality). }} {{Version history table row|3.6.0| * Mana Cost at gem level 1 is now 16 (was 24). * Mana Cost at gem level 20 is now 33 (was 50). * Now causes Normal and Magic enemies to deal 21% less Damage at gem level 1, up to 30% less Damage at gem level 20. * Now causes Rare and Unique enemies to deal 10% less damage at gem level 1, up to 15% less damage at gem level 20 }} {{Version history table row|2.6.0| * Increased Area of Effect mod and its progression per level doubled. }} {{Version history table row|2.3.0| *Enfeeble now causes monsters to only lose 21% Critical Multiplier at Level 1 (down from 40%). This goes up by 1% every 2 gem levels, to -30% at gem level 20. A monster's base Critical Multiplier is +30%, so at level 20 this bonus is nullified. This makes it less effective when the monster has additional Critical Multiplier (through map or monster mods). }} {{Version history table row|2.1.0c| * Temporal Chains, Enfeeble, Curse on Hit and Blasphemy have had their quality bonuses returned to normal. * A cap of 75% now applies to the action speed reduction caused by Temporal Chains and to the effects of Enfeeble. }} {{Version history table row|2.1.0c| * Enfeeble quality now grants 0.5% reduced enemy Critical Strike Multiplier per point of quality. }} {{Version history table row|2.0.0| * Mana cost reduced at all levels. The reduced critical strike chance and critical strike multiplier effects are now 25% at all levels. Area of effect increases per gem level reduced, but the base area of effect has been increased by 37.5% (from 16 to 22). It now grants 0.5% reduced critical strike chance and accuracy on cursed enemies per 1% quality instead of just critical strike chance. }} {{Version history table row|1.2.0| * In addition to the general curse reduction, the duration of Enfeeble has been reduced. }} {{Version history table row|1.0.1| * The accuracy penalty given by quality has been halved. }} {{Version history table row|0.9.2| * Added new skill prototype - "Enfeeble": Curses all targets in an area, making their attacks less effective. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist|refs= {{cite web|author=Mark_GGG|date=February 19, 2014|title=Enfeeble on reflect monsters|url=https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/396092/page/2#p6934533|publisher=Official Path of Exile website|accessdate=November 12, 2015}} {{cite web|url=https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/jmbhl4/default_level_of_curses_if_item_has_curses_enemy/gaubbpf/?context=10|title=Re: Default level of curses? If item has curses enemy with vulnerability with 40% increased effect, is this curse counted as lvl1?|date=November 1, 2020|accessdate=November 9, 2020|publisher=Path of Exile subreddit|author=Mark_GGG}} }} {{Navbox Skills}}
